queries.en: What ordering condition must an array satisfy before binary search can be applied?
queries.zh: 对数组使用二分查找之前，数组需要满足什么有序性条件？

queries.en: Why does repeatedly halving the search interval give binary search logarithmic time complexity?
queries.zh: 为什么搜索区间每轮减半会使二分查找具有对数时间复杂度？

queries.en: Why must deletion in a linear-probing hash table use a tombstone rather than immediately turn the slot into an empty bucket?
queries.zh: 为什么线性探测哈希表删除元素时需要墓碑标记，而不能直接把该位置变成空桶？

queries.en: How can a separate-chaining hash table improve lookup complexity when a bucket contains a very long collision chain?
queries.zh: 链式地址哈希表中某个桶的冲突链表很长时，可以怎样改善查询时间复杂度？

queries.en: How is the balance factor of a node in an AVL tree calculated?
queries.zh: AVL树中一个节点的平衡因子是怎样计算的？

queries.en: How does a stack determine the removal order of elements relative to their insertion order?
queries.zh: 栈中元素的出栈顺序与它们的入栈顺序有什么关系？

queries.en: Which data structure supports breadth-first graph traversal, and what visitation order does it produce?
queries.zh: 图的广度优先遍历通常借助什么数据结构实现，它按照什么顺序访问顶点？

queries.en: When does depth-first graph traversal backtrack, and how does it continue exploring afterwards?
queries.zh: 图的深度优先遍历什么时候回溯，回溯后又怎样继续探索？

queries.en: What does pivot-based partitioning accomplish before Quicksort recursively sorts its subarrays?
queries.zh: 快速排序递归处理子数组之前，围绕基准数的划分操作完成了什么任务？

queries.en: Why can choosing the first array element as Quicksort’s pivot perform badly on reverse-sorted input?
queries.zh: 为什么快速排序在倒序数组上总选首元素作为基准数，可能导致性能很差？

queries.en: Why is insertion sort inexpensive on a nearly sorted list?
queries.zh: 为什么插入排序处理接近有序的列表时开销较低？

queries.en: How does Mergesort’s merge operation choose the next record from two sorted sublists?
queries.zh: 归并排序的合并操作怎样从两个有序子列表中选出下一个输出记录？
